title: China Map of Ancient Towns
synopsis: Travel through time on a journey to three famous ancient towns in China: Wuzhen, Fenghuang, and Pingyao. Explore ancient coastlines and landscapes and experience the lives of ordinary people in history.

fullText.simplified:
中国古镇地图

    想要了解一个国家的历史，如果只看皇帝们的历史，其实是不太真实的。看看普通人吃什么，住在哪儿，是更有意思的事情。在下面这些古镇，可以看到历史上，普通的中国人在做什么。
    乌镇。可以说，乌镇是中国最有名的古镇。要看古镇，不能忘了乌镇。乌镇在中国浙江，是一个南方小镇。乌镇已经有一千多年的历史了，一直都是很重要、很有名的地方。这里有很多条河，这些河都很安全、干净和漂亮，每天都有很多人来这里。除了干净的河和漂亮的老房子，在这里还能看到最新的中国文化，因为很多科技公司每年都会来这里开会。
    凤凰。凤凰在中国湖南，有几百年的历史。凤凰有漂亮的山和水，还有热情的人们。凤凰人喜欢唱歌跳舞，还喜欢喝酒。他们常常穿着漂亮的衣服，一边唱歌跳舞一边喝酒。如果你不太喜欢喝酒，可以去爬山，也可以去坐船。凤凰和乌镇一样，有很多小河，可以坐着小船看山水。
    平遥。平遥在中国北方的山西，是一个北方古镇。平遥在历史上很重要，因为从这里去哪儿都方便。所以，从一千多年前开始，就有很多人在这里做买卖了，这里住着很多有钱人。这里有中国最早的银行，也有最老的城墙，还有历史上有钱人住过的房子。你可以从这些房子上看到特别的中国文化，很有意思。
    这几个地方都有自己的文化，都是以前普通的中国人生活过的地方，是真实历史的样子。如果你想看到不一样的中国，可以去这些地方看一看。
fullText.traditional:
中國古鎮地圖

    想要了解一個國家的歷史，如果只看皇帝們的歷史，其實是不太真實的。看看普通人吃什麼，住在哪兒，是更有意思的事情。在下面這些古鎮，可以看到歷史上，普通的中國人在做什麼。
    烏鎮。可以說，烏鎮是中國最有名的古鎮。要看古鎮，不能忘了烏鎮。烏鎮在中國浙江，是一個南方小鎮。烏鎮已經有一千多年的歷史了，一直都是很重要、很有名的地方。這裡有很多條河，這些河都很安全、乾淨和漂亮，每天都有很多人來這裡。除了乾淨的河和漂亮的老房子，在這裡還能看到最新的中國文化，因為很多科技公司每年都會來這裡開會。
    鳳凰。鳳凰在中國湖南，有幾百年的歷史。鳳凰有漂亮的山和水，還有熱情的人們。鳳凰人喜歡唱歌跳舞，還喜歡喝酒。他們常常穿著漂亮的衣服，一邊唱歌跳舞一邊喝酒。如果你不太喜歡喝酒，可以去爬山，也可以去坐船。鳳凰和烏鎮一樣，有很多小河，可以坐著小船看山水。
    平遙。平遙在中國北方的山西，是一個北方古鎮。平遙在歷史上很重要，因為從這裡去哪兒都方便。所以，從一千多年前開始，就有很多人在這裡做買賣了，這裡住著很多有錢人。這裡有中國最早的銀行，也有最老的城牆，還有歷史上有錢人住過的房子。你可以從這些房子上看到特別的中國文化，很有意思。
    這幾個地方都有自己的文化，都是以前普通的中國人生活過的地方，是真實歷史的樣子。如果你想看到不一樣的中國，可以去這些地方看一看。

sentences.english: Wuzhen is in Zhejiang, China, and is a small town in the south.

sentences.simplified: 这里有很多条河，这些河都很安全、干净和漂亮，每天都有很多人来这里。

sentences.english: Wuzhen has a history of more than 1,000 years of history and has always been a very important and famous place.

sentences.simplified: 除了干净的河和漂亮的老房子，在这里还能看到最新的中国文化，

sentences.simplified: 因为很多科技公司每年都会来这里开会。
sentences.traditional: 因為很多科技公司每年都會來這裡開會。

sentences.english: Other than the clean rivers and beautiful old houses, you can also see the newest developments in Chinese culture here, ..
.. because lots of tech companies come here every year to hold meetings.

sentences.simplified: 凤凰。凤凰在中国湖南，有几百年的历史。
sentences.traditional: 鳳凰。鳳凰在中國湖南，有幾百年的歷史。

sentences.simplified: 凤凰有漂亮的山和水，还有热情的人们。
sentences.traditional: 鳳凰有漂亮的山和水，還有熱情的人們。
sentences.pinyin: fèng huáng yǒu piào liang de shān hé shuǐ hái yǒu rè qíng de rén men
sentences.english: Fenghuang. Fenghuang is in Hunan, China, and has hundreds of years of history.

sentences.simplified: 凤凰人喜欢唱歌跳舞，还喜欢喝酒。
sentences.traditional: 鳳凰人喜歡唱歌跳舞，還喜歡喝酒。
sentences.pinyin: fèng huáng rén xǐ huan chàng gē tiào wǔ hái xǐ huan hē jiǔ
sentences.english: Fenghuang has beautiful mountains and rivers and also has passionate people.

sentences.simplified: 他们常常穿着漂亮的衣服，一边唱歌跳舞一边喝酒。
sentences.traditional: 他們常常穿著漂亮的衣服，一邊唱歌跳舞一邊喝酒。
sentences.pinyin: tā men cháng cháng chuān zhe piào liang de yī fu yì biān chàng gē tiào wǔ yì biān hē jiǔ
sentences.english: People from Fenghuang like singing and dancing and also like drinking.

sentences.simplified: 如果你不太喜欢喝酒，可以去爬山，也可以去坐船。
sentences.traditional: 如果你不太喜歡喝酒，可以去爬山，也可以去坐船。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ bù tài xǐ huan hē jiǔ kě yǐ qù pá shān yě kě yǐ qù zuò chuán

sentences.simplified: 凤凰和乌镇一样，有很多小河，可以坐着小船看山水。
sentences.traditional: 鳳凰和烏鎮一樣，有很多小河，可以坐著小船看山水。

sentences.english: If you don’t really like drinking, you can go hiking, and you can also take a boat ride.
Like Wuzhen, Fenghuang has many small rivers. You can take a ride on a small boat to see the scenery.

sentences.traditional: 平遙。平遙在中國北方的山西，是一個北方古鎮。

sentences.english: Pingyao. Pingyao is in the north of China in Shanxi and is a northern ancient town.

sentences.simplified: 所以，从一千多年前开始，就有很多人在这里做买卖了，这里住着很多有钱人。
sentences.traditional: 所以，從一千多年前開始，就有很多人在這裡做買賣了，這裡住著很多有錢人。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ cóng yì qiān duō nián qián kāi shǐ jiù yǒu hěn duō rén zài zhè lǐ zuò mǎi mài le zhè lǐ zhù zhe hěn duō yǒu qián rén
sentences.english: Pingyao is very important in history because it is very convenient to get anywhere from here.

sentences.simplified: 这里有中国最早的银行，也有最老的城墙，还有历史上有钱人住过的房子。
sentences.traditional: 這裡有中國最早的銀行，也有最老的城牆，還有歷史上有錢人住過的房子。
sentences.pinyin: zhè lǐ yǒu zhōng guó zuì zǎo de yín háng yě yǒu zuì lǎo de chéng qiáng hái yǒu lì shǐ shang yǒu qián rén zhù guò de fáng zi
sentences.english: Therefore, since more than 1,000 years ago, many people have been doing business here, and many wealthy people have lived here.

sentences.simplified: 你可以从这些房子上看到特别的中国文化，很有意思。
sentences.traditional: 你可以從這些房子上看到特別的中國文化，很有意思。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ kě yǐ cóng zhè xiē fáng zi shang kàn dào tè bié de zhōng guó wén huà hěn yǒu yì si
sentences.english: China’s earliest banks were here, as well as the oldest city walls and the houses where the richest people in history lived.
You can see the unique Chinese culture from these houses. It’s really interesting.

sentences.simplified: 这几个地方都有自己的文化，都是以前普通的中国人生活过的地方，

sentences.traditional: 是真實歷史的樣子。
sentences.pinyin: shì zhēn shí lì shǐ de yàng zi
sentences.english: These few places all have their own culture, and all are places where ordinary Chinese people lived in the past.

sentences.simplified: 如果你想看到不一样的中国，可以去这些地方看一看。
sentences.traditional: 如果你想看到不一樣的中國，可以去這些地方看一看。

sentences.english: This is what real history looks like.

sentence_translations: China Map of Ancient Towns
If you want to understand a country’s history, just looking at the history of the emperors is actually not very realistic.
Looking at what ordinary people ate and where they lived is more interesting.
In these ancient towns, you can see what ordinary Chinese people were doing throughout history.
Wuzhen. It can be said that Wuzhen is the most famous ancient town in China.
If you want to see ancient towns, you should not forget Wuzhen.
Wuzhen is in Zhejiang, China, and is a small town in the south.
Wuzhen has a history of more than 1,000 years of history and has always been a very important and famous place.
There are many rivers here, all of which are safe, clean, and beautiful, and many people come here every day.
Other than the clean rivers and beautiful old houses, you can also see the newest developments in Chinese culture here, ..
.. because lots of tech companies come here every year to hold meetings.
Fenghuang. Fenghuang is in Hunan, China, and has hundreds of years of history.
Fenghuang has beautiful mountains and rivers and also has passionate people.
People from Fenghuang like singing and dancing and also like drinking.
They often wear beautiful clothes, singing and dancing whilst drinking.
If you don’t really like drinking, you can go hiking, and you can also take a boat ride.
Like Wuzhen, Fenghuang has many small rivers. You can take a ride on a small boat to see the scenery.
Pingyao. Pingyao is in the north of China in Shanxi and is a northern ancient town.
Pingyao is very important in history because it is very convenient to get anywhere from here.
Therefore, since more than 1,000 years ago, many people have been doing business here, and many wealthy people have lived here.
China’s earliest banks were here, as well as the oldest city walls and the houses where the richest people in history lived.
You can see the unique Chinese culture from these houses. It’s really interesting.
These few places all have their own culture, and all are places where ordinary Chinese people lived in the past.
This is what real history looks like.
If you want to see a different side of China, you can go to these places and have a look.
